candidate.definition_en: To carry the weight of; to support or endure.
candidate.explanation_ar: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة، أو يشيل مسؤولية، وساعات بتيجي بمعنى يحمل 'زي يحمل اسم'.

senses.definition_en: To tolerate or endure an unpleasant or painful situation.
senses.definition_ar: يتحمل أو يطيق أمراً صعباً أو مؤلماً
examples: He could not bear the pain any longer.

senses.definition_en: To hold up or support a weight or burden.
senses.definition_ar: يحمل أو يتحمل وزناً أو عبئاً
examples: The bridge was designed to bear the weight of heavy trucks.
The bridge was designed to bear the weight of heavy trucks.
